curation.notes: AFM force spectroscopy (indentation breakthrough forces) on plasma-membrane patches, GPMVs and supported planar bilayers from whole-cell lipid extracts of wild-type and SPTLC1-deficient HAP1 cells grown under sphingolipid-limiting conditions; this is membrane mechanics by tip indentation rather than single-molecule tethering.
